### LOW: Untrusted heartbeat telemetry now sets the fleet prefill median used for exploration pricing
[coordinator/registry/heartbeat\.go:385](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/f0e71d3b40794b8811f5eaf394500ea693c0e800/coordinator/registry/heartbeat.go#L385) · ADV-001, T-006, TB-002

This PR adds a fleet\-median isolated\-prefill store \(tps\_prefill\.go RecordPrefill/PrefillMedian\)\. heartbeat\.go now records each slot's self\-reported isolated prefill rate into it, keyed by model and the provider's self\-reported chip family\.  The only filter is a range clamp: values that are non\-finite, non\-positive or above maxPrefillTPS \(20000\) are dropped\. Nothing checks the reporter's trust level, attestation state or challenge freshness\. Providers still in the async attestation window, or already marked untrusted, still contribute samples\.  The new exploration pricing in first\_content\_exploration\_pricing\.go and scheduler\.go resolvePrefillTPS treats this median as authoritative\. It applies to any exploration\-admitted provider whose own prefill evidence is missing or at least 5 minutes old\.  Trigger: a few adversarial or sybil registrations \(ADV\-001, enabled by the open SEC\-034/T\-006\) heartbeat in\-range but inflated isolated\_prefill\_tps for a common model and chip family\. This shifts the median\.  Impact: idle providers with stale evidence, including the attacker's own nodes, are priced as fast\. They win reservations over measured peers and miss first\-content targets\. The result is routing\-share skew and latency degradation\. Trust, encryption and billing gates are not affected\.  Fix: \- Record fleet samples only from hardware\-trusted, routable connections with a fresh verified challenge\. \- Bound each provider's weight in the ring\. \- Prefer coordinator\-measured TTFT and throughput over provider\-reported rates\.
